Name flags from the Hanabi demo, Jack Heart: "i just find it confusing that --name is te middle thing -- not the overall experiment name, and not hte unique name", then on flags named for what they set: "and then yeah i agree with the flags matching what they set". Replace --name with: --run NAME, the run's unique name exactly as typed (no -seed-N suffix); --job NAME, the middle level, only needed when one config fans out over several seeds, which then makes JOB-seed-N runs; --experiment unchanged (file stem default). --resume takes the run name, with the experiment from the file (hanabi/team-seed-0 style still accepted). --run with several seeds is refused, pointing at --job (chosen by the operator, not Jack). Apply to etude train, and to launch/continue/eval wherever they name these levels. The run_name_taken refusal prints the full command to continue, including --until. Words in scratch/demo-hanabi.md.
